text: A big **54-slot** store for camp supplies, with a trick a chest does not have: set its faces, and it feeds or empties the Tribal Power machines touching it, with no hopper and no relay.

pages.title: Setting its faces
text: Open it and use the IO pad to set each face to **Input**, **Output**, **Both** or **Closed**. Crouching and right-clicking a face with an empty hand cycles it too.

Touching Tribal Power machines pass up to **16 items a second** across a face that gives (Output or Both) into a face that takes (Input or Both). Two Both faces never trade, so stacks cannot ping-pong between them.
A station's bottom face is Output, so a cache sitting under a station catches everything it makes. Set a face to Output against a station's Input side and it feeds the station.

steps.caption: Set an Ancestral Cache down where the output should go.
Stand Echo Shatter on top of it; a station's bottom face is Output.
Give Shatter its Earth totem and Pulse, as usual.
Shards now drop straight into the cache, no hopper needed.

pages.title: Tips
text: Hoppers and pipes honour the same face settings, so a Closed face turns them away too.
Neighbours use faces; relays are for distance. See [Wireless cargo](wireless_cargo).
A lever locks both the menu and the automation. A comparator reads how full it is.

pages.title: The tidy button
text: Every inventory worth tidying carries a small **Tidy** button in the empty corner above its slots: your own pack, this cache, the [Deep Cache](deep_cache), and any chest, barrel, shulker box or hopper.

A press merges what can be merged and lays the rest out in order. Your hotbar and your armour are never moved, and a machine's slots are left alone — the button only appears where every slot takes anything.
Turn it off with **sortButtons** in the client config if it crowds another mod's screen.
